supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:29 UTC, Explorer wrote a UserAssist registry value whose ROT13-encoded path decodes to C:\Windows\System32\mstsc.exe.
The supplied records do not establish that mstsc.exe ran at that time or that an RDP session was initiated; the UserAssist value alone does not demonstrate either.

WS-CPRICE-01 made SMB connections to DC-RB-01 at 13:51 and 14:10 UTC. The DC-side network events identify the application as System, and the corresponding logons identify the account as WS-CPRICE-01$.
Three local interactive logon attempts for cole.price failed with an incorrect-password status between 14:19:09 and 14:19:15 UTC; the records do not show who entered the credentials or why.
